q: [T]he ejoo, used by the Malay pirates for their cables, is procured from the sago tree, a species of palm.
1841 February 16, The Australian, Sydney, page 3, column 2:
The midribs of the leaves of many of the palms, a stronger and stouter substance than the kittool and ejoo fibres of Ceylon and the East, are what is wanted[.]
